note: A family-run campground in the woods outside Bethlehem, open since 1972, with separate tent areas, group areas, trailer storage and winter camping. Sells summer and winter seasonal sites as well as nights. --Claude
summary: Operator's old site (2024 prices) + newer site + map + Google: full hookups (30/50 A) $40, tents $30, extra adult/teen $8; map shows ~67 sites with pull-throughs; showers/flush/dump/store/laundry/propane; year-round; phone booking. Google 4.9 (7). Price gate passes at $40. Nightly share unmeasured (canopy hides the sites). Note rewritten.
flags: PRIVATE GATE: price passes - cheapest RV night $40 (full hookups, one rate all year, so the summer peak is also $40), operator rates page headed '2024 PRICES' (the newest posted; no 2025/2026 rate found; the newer site posts no rates). Not in the Good Sam directory cache; no gateway within 40 km. GOOGLE: 4.9 stars from 7 reviews (under 25). RV Life stored 4 stars / $$. Presence: two working operator websites with phone 603-869-2238.

LONG-STAY: nightly share NOT measured. The rates page posts nightly ($40/$30), weekly ($240/$180) and summer ($1,300) and winter ($1,100) seasonal rates and leads with the nightly rates; nothing discourages nightly guests; no standing minimum; no lot sales; no age rule. The map marks no seasonal rows. Esri imagery (44.2905,-71.6718) shows the loops under continuous canopy with only a few units visible near the office, so the share cannot be read.
